board: Amphenol Telaire T6713 module (bare board, 6-pin 2.54 mm header: SDA, SCL, V+, GND, PWM, CTRL)
reason: Modbus-over-I2C at 0x15 is modelled as command responses: 04 13 8B 00 01 returns 04 02 MSB LSB with ppm = MSB*256+LSB, and the status register reads back as OK. CTRL is tied to GND to select I2C, SCL gets an external 4.7k pull-up to 3V3, and VCC comes from 5 V. The check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the second run; the first run also passed, but its SCL pull-up went to 5 V, which was moved to 3V3.
